subject: KPI triage: pre-QBR ownership & quick wins
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Jordan Smith <jordan@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: NexCloud CS Ops <ops@nexcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: KPI triage: pre-QBR ownership & quick wins

Team —

Quick pre-QBR triage. I pulled the May KPI snapshot (attached) and ran the delta against April. High-level callouts:

- Latency: p50 stable (~48ms) but p95 increased from 380ms -> 450ms (+18%). Spike coincides with region-b failover window on 5/17.
- Cost: unit cost per 1M tokens up ~12% month-over-month; reserve utilization for Dedicated pools is low (70%).
- Uptime: rolling 30d at 99.95% but we had two short regional flaps that bumped user-facing errors during peak.
- Usage: overall inference requests +22% MoM; new sandbox tenant traffic accounted for ~6% of the growth.

Asking for owners so we can present a one-slide remediation & risk summary in Wednesday's Preflight (QBR dry-run):
- Latency (p95 regressions) — owner? suggest Markus K.
- Cost (unit economics & quick ops wins) — owner? suggest Tessa M.
- Uptime (root cause + mitigations for region failovers) — owner? suggest Irene C.
- Usage / product noise (sanbox tenant impact + attribution) — owner? suggest Laura B.

Please reply with: 1) accept/decline ownership, 2) top 2 short-term actions + ETA (48–72h), and 3) any data or traces you need (I can share region logs and the trace dump).

Attachments: kpi_snapshot_may2028.xlsx (dashboard + tokenized detail). Dashboard link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/qbr/preflight-kpi-2028

If we can lock owners today, I’ll synthesize a single slide and distribute before Tuesday standup.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Ops Lead, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KPI triage: pre-QBR ownership & quick wins

Vanessa — I’ll take latency p95 ownership.

Immediate plan (48h):
- Roll a targeted kernel set lock for the top 3 model families during peak windows (should reduce tail variance). ETA: config ship by Tue EOD.
- Enable conservative continuous batching for region-b trial group (10% traffic) to smooth microbursts. ETA: rollout by Wed morning.

Need from you: full trace bundle for 5/17 failover window + sample request IDs (I’ll add a short list of request IDs after I’ve scanned the trace).

-Markus

Subject: Re: KPI triage: pre-QBR ownership & quick wins

Taking cost ownership. Quick read and proposed quick wins (48–72h):

1) Short-term ops moves (low-risk):
   - Reduce cache TTL for hot prefixes from 30m -> 10m (estimated 6% saving on token regen).
   - Enable model-level quantization pilot for the largest open model (batchable) in a blue/green canary (expected 8–12% CPU/GPU cost improvement for that workload).

2) Medium-term (2–3 weeks):
   - Rebalance Dedicated reserves to match observed peak percentiles (target 85–90% utilization to avoid burst cost).

Estimate: combined short-term moves -> ~10% delta on current unit cost (conservative). I attached a quick calc note (cost_ops_notes.pdf).

Jordan — FYI on the quantization pilot; procurement chat will be needed if we scale to additional node types.

Tessa
Sr. Cloud Economist (Ops)
Redwood Inference

  - Cost: Tessa Morgan — actions: cache TTL + quantization pilot. ETA: short-term changes by Thu EOD.
  - Uptime: Irene Choi — actions: postmortem of 5/17 region-b failover, add a stricter health-check gating for regional failover, improve fallback policy. RCA draft by Thu EOD.
  - Usage attribution: Laura Bennett — action: break down sandbox tenant traffic and propose quota controls. ETA: Tue noon.

- Deliverables for Preflight (Wed dry-run):
  1) One-slide risk + mitigation per metric (I will consolidate).
  2) Short bullets on user impact and OKR implications (we should call out any >0.5% QBR hit to availability OKR).

I attached the consolidated KPI snapshot again for visibility. I’ll start the RCA timeline and invite the infra runbook owners for a quick sync.
